description: Defines options structures for embedding and embedding bag modules in the torch::nn namespace, including EmbeddingOptions, EmbeddingFromPretrainedOptions, EmbeddingFuncOptions, EmbeddingBagOptions, EmbeddingBagFromPretrainedOptions, and EmbeddingBagFuncOptions.

classes.name: EmbeddingOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring the Embedding module, including parameters like number of embeddings, embedding dimension, padding index, max norm, norm type, gradient scaling, sparsity, and weights.

classes.name: EmbeddingFromPretrainedOptions
classes.description: Options for loading pretrained embeddings with parameters like freeze, padding index, max norm, norm type, and gradient scaling.

classes.name: EmbeddingFuncOptions
classes.description: Options for functional embedding operations, including padding index, max norm, norm type, gradient scaling, and sparsity.

classes.name: EmbeddingBagOptions
classes.description: Options for the EmbeddingBag module, including parameters like number of embeddings, embedding dimension, max norm, norm type, gradient scaling, mode, weights, offsets, and padding index.

classes.name: EmbeddingBagFromPretrainedOptions
classes.description: Options for pretrained EmbeddingBag, including freeze, max norm, norm type, gradient scaling, mode, offsets, and padding index.

classes.name: EmbeddingBagFuncOptions
classes.description: Options for functional EmbeddingBag, including offsets, max norm, norm type, gradient scaling, mode, weights, include_last_offset, and padding index.
